gun.ssjj_dimension.dimension_star2.name: Dimension Star II
gun.ssjj_dimension.dimension_star2.desc: Astral Shell · RMB melee: 15 · Dimension Mark: 50% tighter spread, no damage falloff. Each pellet adds a mark (5 per enemy). Each mark detonates every 0.5 seconds for the pellet damage and heals 1% max HP on damage. Duration: 3s. [Dimension Field] V toggles high energy. Stopping retains charge; refill at the full-bar rate of 5s. Duration follows charge (15s full), usable before full. Marks: every 0.5s, heal 1% max HP. Field radius: 5 blocks, shared by all skins of this tier. [Dimension Decoy] Shift during high energy: eight-way horizontal WASD dash, immediate standing decoy, 99% reduction for 1s, translucent own first-person view and complete external invisibility, 4s cooldown; 3s decoy retaliates once and creates an extra field. Overload: 0.1% damage in 5s, persistent until main-hand switch, then recover in 3s. Values shown are defaults; the server configuration applies.
